_comment: Cash in the Prime Minister's Disaster Relief Fund. The 12 Bhadra nine-bank table (Rs 6,553,362,011), the 15 Bhadra receipts (Rs 600,220,106) and the 17 Bhadra cheque handover (Rs 152,162,045.91, 28 individuals and institutions, received by the Finance Minister) close at Rs 7,305,744,162.91. The rows here are whole rupees, so the 91 paisa is dropped rather than rounded up. The bulletin at nirajbhusal.github.io is someone else's aggregation; the Ministry of Finance / PMDRF figures are the source. Two rules: (1) the pre-disaster balance is already inside the 7.30 billion — never add it again; (2) PhonePe QR, foreign pledges, in-kind cargo and the IFRC DREF are not this fund and are never added to it. app/domains/flood/content.py re-adds the bank rows at load.

headline.label_en: In the PM Disaster Relief Fund
Already in the fund before the flood

breakdowns.title_en: By bank, plus 15 and 17 Bhadra receipts
breakdowns.caption_en: Nine banks, 12 Bhadra (Rs 6.55 billion) plus 15 Bhadra receipts (Rs 600 million) plus the 17 Bhadra cheque handover (Rs 152 million from 28 individuals and institutions) = Rs 7.30 billion. The published figure is Rs 7,305,744,162.91; these rows are whole rupees. That equals 5.13 billion collected after the flood plus 2.17 billion already held. The USD line is a separate label.
breakdowns.caption_ne: नौ बैंक, १२ भदौ (रु. ६ अर्ब ५५ करोड) + १५ भदौ (रु. ६० करोड २ लाख) + १७ भदौ चेक हस्तान्तरण (२८ व्यक्ति/संस्था, रु. १५ करोड २१ लाख) = रु. ७ अर्ब ३० करोड। प्रकाशित अंक रु. ७,३०,५७,४४,१६२.९१ हो; यहाँका पङ्क्ति पूरा रुपैयाँमा छन्। विपद्पछि ५ अर्ब १३ करोड + मौज्दात २ अर्ब १७ करोड। डलर छुट्टै लेबल हो।
breakdowns.do_not_merge_en: The 2.17 billion already in the fund is inside the 7.30 billion, not on top of it. USD 3.19 million is not part of the Nepali-rupee total. Jensen Huang's USD 10 million is a contribution to this fund but is not yet inside the 7.30 billion cash figure. PhonePe QR Rs 1.97 billion, foreign pledges, World Bank Rs 25 billion and the IFRC appeal are not this fund.
breakdowns.do_not_merge_ne: विपद्अघिको २ अर्ब १७ करोड ७ अर्ब ३० करोडभित्र छ, माथि होइन। डलर ३१.९ लाख नेपाली जम्मामा होइन। जेन्सेन ह्वाङको १ करोड डलर यही कोषमा गएको योगदान हो तर ७ अर्ब ३० करोडको नगद अंकभित्र अझै छैन। फोनपे QR रु. १ अर्ब ९६ करोड, वैदेशिक घोषणा, विश्व बैंक २५ अर्ब र आईएफआरसी अपिल यो कोष होइनन्।

items.label_en: 17 Bhadra cheque handover (28 individuals and institutions)

aside.label_en: USD account (~Rs 48.6 crore at NRB 152.57, 28 Aug)

breakdowns.caption_en: UK $6.79m + US $3.6m + OCHA $3.2m + South Korea $1m + ADB $5m + UAE $10m + Jensen Huang $10m. These are pledges and contributions announced outside the published rupee balance, not cash counted in the Prime Minister's fund table.
breakdowns.caption_ne: बेलायत $६.७९ मि. + अमेरिका $३.६ मि. + ओसीएचए $३.२ मि. + दक्षिण कोरिया $१ मि. + एडीबी $५ मि. + युएई $१० मि. + जेन्सेन ह्वाङ $१० मि.। यी प्रकाशित रुपैयाँ मौज्दातबाहिरका घोषणा/योगदान हुन्, कोषको तालिकामा गनिएको नगद होइनन्।
breakdowns.do_not_merge_en: Not added to the Rs 7.30 billion. World Bank Rs 25 billion and the IFRC CHF 25 million appeal are separate lines, not inside this $39.59 million. ADB $5m and UAE $10m are pledges, not cash received. UAE's 83-tonne flight is inside the $10m package, not on top of it. Jensen Huang's $10m (about Rs 1.51 billion) is a contribution to the Prime Minister's fund that the published rupee balance does not yet carry — count it once, here.
breakdowns.do_not_merge_ne: रु. ७ अर्ब ३० करोडमा जोडिँदैन। विश्व बैंक २५ अर्ब र आईएफआरसी CHF २५ मिलियन अपिल यो $३९.५९ मिलियनभित्र होइनन्। एडीबी $५ मिलियन र युएई $१० मिलियन घोषणा हुन्, आएको नगद होइनन्। युएईको ८३ टन उडान $१० मिलियनभित्र छ, माथि होइन। जेन्सेन ह्वाङको $१० मिलियन (करिब रु. १.५१ अर्ब) प्रधानमन्त्री कोषमा गएको योगदान हो जुन प्रकाशित रुपैयाँ मौज्दातले अझै समेटेको छैन — एक पटक, यहीँ गन्नुहोस्।

exclusive.detail_en: Arthasansar citing PM Shah to Parliament: Rs 7,008,857,217 across the PM Disaster Relief Fund and the PM Relief Fund together — not a replacement for the MoF nine-bank table of Rs 7.30 billion, and not added onto it. After the Rs 1 billion release the speech cites an NPR balance of 6,008,857,217 (dollar accounts separate). USD 6,141,702 also cited in the same speech — a different dollar label from the MoF USD ~3.19 million aside on the bank panel.
exclusive.detail_ne: अर्थसंसार, प्रधानमन्त्री शाह प्रतिनिधिसभामा: प्रधानमन्त्री दैवी प्रकोप उद्धार कोष र प्रधानमन्त्री राहत कोषमा संयुक्त रु. ७,००८,८५७,२१७ — MoF नौ-बैंक तालिकाको रु. ७.३० अर्बको सट्टा होइन, त्यसमाथि जोडिँदैन। १ अर्ब निकासापछि भाषणले NPR मौज्दात ६,००८,८५७,२१७ भनेको (डलर खाता छुट्टै)। सोही भाषणमा USD ६,१४१,७०२ — बैंक प्यानलको ~३.१९ मिलियन डलर लेबलभन्दा फरक।

exclusive.detail_en: MoHA monsoon command, 16 Bhadra — Rasuwa, Nuwakot, Dhading, Gorkha and Tanahun palikas. Matches the 11 Bhadra DRRM executive-committee allocation; count once. Not the PM fund cash total. 75+100+30+20 + 150+75+25+50 + 30+20+20+20 + 20 + 20+20 = 675 lakh.
exclusive.detail_ne: गृह, मनसुन कमाण्ड, १६ भदौ — रसुवा, नुवाकोट, धादिङ, गोरखा र तनहुँका पालिका। ११ भदौको विपद् कार्यकारी समितिको विनियोजनसँग मेल; एक पटक मात्र गन्नुहोस्। प्रधानमन्त्री कोषको मौज्दात होइन। ७५+१००+३०+२० + १५०+७५+२५+५० + ३०+२०+२०+२० + २० + २०+२० = ६७५ लाख।
